🔨 WhackAMole

Moles pop out of holes at random, and you must whack them before they disappear. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Click or tap on moles as soon as they appear from their holes.
  2. Moles only stay visible for a short time — react quickly.
  3. Missing a mole or clicking an empty hole may cost you a life.
  4. The game speeds up as your score increases.
  5. Watch for patterns — moles occasionally appear in the same hole consecutively.
